title: Climate-Change Pledges, Actions and Outcomes
title_zh: 气候变化承诺、行动与结果
title_primary: 气候变化承诺、行动与结果
title_secondary: Climate-Change Pledges, Actions and Outcomes
authors: Tiloka de Silva, Silvana Tenreyro
official: 官方在线 2026-01-12 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study countries' compliance with the targets pledged in international climate-change agreements and the impact of those agreements and specific climate laws and policies on greenhouse-gas emissions and economic outcomes. To do so, we compile and codify data on international agreements and measures enacted at the national and sub-national levels. We find that compliance with targets has been mixed. Still, countries that signed the Kyoto Protocol or the Copenhagen Accord experienced significant reductions in emissions when compared to non-signatories. Having quantifiable targets led to further reductions. Effects from the Paris Agreement are not yet evident in the data. Carbon taxes and the introduction of emission-trading schemes led to material reductions in emissions. Other climate laws or policies do not appear to have had, individually, a material effect on emissions. The impact on GDP growth or inflation from most measures was largely insignificant. Overall, much more ambitious targets would be needed to offset the impact of economic and population growth on emissions and contain the expansion of the stock of gases.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了各国对国际气候变化协议中设定目标的遵守情况，以及这些协议和具体的气候法律与政策对温室气体排放和经济成果的影响。为此，我们汇编并系统整理了关于国际协议及国家和次国家级层面实施措施的数据。研究发现，对目标的遵守情况参差不齐。尽管如此，与未签署国相比，签署《京都议定书》或《哥本哈根协议》的国家在排放量上实现了显著减少。设定可量化的目标进一步促进了减排。而《巴黎协定》的效果在数据中尚未显现。碳税和排放交易体系的引入带来了实质性的减排效果。其他气候法律或政策单独来看，并未对排放产生显著影响。大多数措施对GDP增长或通货膨胀的影响基本不显著。总体而言，需要更为宏大的目标来抵消经济和人口增长对排放的影响，并控制温室气体存量的扩张。

title: Climate Change and Economic Dynamics: Temperature‐Dependent Shock Propagation
title_zh: 气候变化与经济动态：温度依赖的冲击传导
title_primary: 气候变化与经济动态：温度依赖的冲击传导
title_secondary: Climate Change and Economic Dynamics: Temperature‐Dependent Shock Propagation
authors: Christian Glocker, Thomas Url
official: 官方在线 2026-08-04 · 来源：RSS
abstract: The gradual rise in temperatures motivates conceptualizing climate change as a phenomenon shaping the propagation of macroeconomic shocks, rather than as an independent shock. We formalize this in a theoretical model, showing that climate change induces a structural shift by steepening the aggregate supply curve, exacerbating the price effects of demand shocks while dampening the output response. Our empirical evidence is consistent with this prediction: higher temperatures raise the share of inflation variation attributable to demand shocks by up to 10 percentage points, underscoring the role of climate change in intensifying stagflationary dynamics rather than independently driving business cycles.
abstract_zh: 气温的逐步上升促使我们将气候变化概念化为一种塑造宏观经济冲击传播的现象，而非独立冲击。我们在理论模型中对此进行了形式化，表明气候变化通过使总供给曲线更加陡峭引发结构性转变，加剧了需求冲击的价格效应，同时削弱了产出响应。我们的实证证据与这一预测一致：气温升高使需求冲击导致的通胀变动份额最多增加10个百分点，凸显了气候变化在加剧滞胀动态而非独立驱动商业周期中的作用。

title: The anti-corruption campaign and the intergenerational transmission of bureaucratic employment: Evidence from China
title_zh: 反腐败运动与官僚就业的代际传递：来自中国的证据
title_primary: 反腐败运动与官僚就业的代际传递：来自中国的证据
title_secondary: The anti-corruption campaign and the intergenerational transmission of bureaucratic employment: Evidence from China
authors: Shuai Chen, Erqi Ge
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: 来源期次 2026-08-01 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Inequality in bureaucratic employment, favoring individuals from bureaucratic family backgrounds, is widespread. Using China’s recent anti-corruption campaign as a quasi-experiment, we examine how intensified counter-corruption efforts reshape intergenerational occupational transmission within the public sector. Employing a difference-in-differences approach, we compare changes in the likelihood of bureaucratic employment for children of bureaucrats versus non-bureaucrats before and after the campaign implementation across provinces. Prior to the campaign, offspring of bureaucrats were over 13 percentage points more likely to work in the bureaucracy; following the campaign, this advantage diminished by more than 5 percentage points. Further analyses suggest that relatively better outside options for bureaucrats’ children serve as a mechanism, while alternative explanations, such as asymmetric insider information, shifts in risk preferences, or changes in perceptions of bureaucracy, are not supported by the data. Our findings highlight how anti-corruption initiatives can reduce entrenched dynastic privileges and promote greater equality of opportunity within public institutions.
abstract_zh: 官僚就业中的不平等现象普遍存在，倾向于青睐具有官僚家庭背景的个体。利用中国近期反腐败运动作为准自然实验，我们考察了加强的反腐努力如何重塑公共部门内的代际职业传递。采用双重差分方法，我们比较了运动实施前后各省份官僚子女与非官僚子女进入官僚机构就业概率的变化。运动前，官僚子女进入官僚机构工作的可能性高出超过13个百分点；运动后，这一优势缩小了5个多百分点。进一步分析表明，官僚子女相对更优的外部选择机会是一个作用机制，而其他替代性解释，如信息不对称的内部人优势、风险偏好变化或对官僚机构认知的改变，均未得到数据支持。我们的研究结果凸显了反腐败举措如何能够削弱根深蒂固的世袭特权，并促进公共机构内机会平等的提升。

title: “Show Me!” The Informativeness of images in firms’ annual reports
title_zh: 展示给我看！”企业年报中图像的信息含量
title_primary: 展示给我看！”企业年报中图像的信息含量
title_secondary: “Show Me!” The Informativeness of images in firms’ annual reports
authors: Azi Ben-Rephael, Joshua Ronen, Tavy Ronen, Mi Zhou
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-21 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We consider how images (i.e., photos but not graphs, charts, or infographics) in annual reports provide users with information and use machine-learning algorithms to assess their informativeness. We develop a metric of content reinforcement, defined as the degree to which information investors extract from images complements and reinforces details in textual narratives. We find that firms are more likely to use images when they experience greater asset growth, have greater business complexity, and provide less readable textual disclosures—suggesting images are used more often when information processing costs are high. Our main results indicate that increases in visual prevalence and the extent to which images reinforce text are associated with greater analyst forecast accuracy and lower dispersion, suggesting that images improve users’ information processing. Firms also increase image use after an exogenous decline in analyst coverage. Overall, firms use images when their information environment is poorer, and visual informativeness facilitates information assimilation.
abstract_zh: 我们探讨了年度报告中图像（即照片，而非图表、图形或信息图）如何向用户提供信息，并运用机器学习算法评估其信息含量。我们构建了一个内容强化指标，定义为投资者从图像中提取的信息与文本叙述中的细节相互补充并强化的程度。研究发现，当企业资产增长较快、业务复杂度较高且文本披露可读性较低时，企业更倾向于使用图像——这表明在信息处理成本较高的情况下，图像的使用更为频繁。我们的主要结果表明，视觉呈现度的提升以及图像对文本强化程度的增加，与分析师的预测准确度提高和预测离散度降低相关，从而说明图像改善了用户的信息处理能力。此外，在分析师覆盖范围出现外生性下降后，企业也会增加图像的使用。总体而言，企业在信息环境较差时更倾向于使用图像，而视觉信息有助于促进信息的吸收与整合。

title: Contesting Influence: U.S. Aid Responses to Chinese Financing
title_zh: 争夺影响力：美国对中国融资的援助回应
title_primary: 争夺影响力：美国对中国融资的援助回应
title_secondary: Contesting Influence: U.S. Aid Responses to Chinese Financing
authors: Emmanuel Caiazzo (Parthenope University of Naples and MoFiR.), Pietro Panizza (University of Calabria), Alberto Zazzaro (University of Naples Federico II, CSEF and MoFiR.)
official: 官方在线 2026-07-20 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Competition between the United States and China is likely to shape the course of history in the coming years. Does foreign aid constitute an arena of confrontation? Using the OECD Creditor Reporting System and the Global Chinese Development Finance Dataset, we study the relationship between the aid-commitment strategies of Beijing and Washington. Employing an instrumental variables approach, we find that the United States increases its aid commitments in recipient countries where China commits more funds. The effect is stronger when the United States has close political or commercial ties with the recipient country and is larger in years of heightened US–China political disagreement. These findings are consistent with a framework in which the two countries compete to acquire influence over the recipient countries.
abstract_zh: 美国与中国之间的竞争很可能在未来数年塑造历史进程。对外援助是否构成对抗的一个领域？利用经合组织债权人报告系统及全球中国发展融资数据集，我们研究了北京与华盛顿的援助承诺策略之间的关系。采用工具变量方法，我们发现美国在中国承诺更多资金援助的受援国增加了其援助承诺。当美国与受援国存在紧密的政治或商业联系时，这一效应更为显著，且在美中政治分歧加剧的年份里影响更大。这些发现与两国竞相获取对受援国影响力的框架相吻合。

title: Competition and Productivity in Middle East and Central Asia: What Role Do Tariffs Play?
title_zh: 中东与中亚的竞争与生产率：关税扮演何种角色？
title_primary: 中东与中亚的竞争与生产率：关税扮演何种角色？
title_secondary: Competition and Productivity in Middle East and Central Asia: What Role Do Tariffs Play?
authors: Walid Faris & Mr. Etibar Jafarov & Umang Rawat
official: 官方在线 2026-07-10 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Across much of the Middle East and Central Asia (ME&CA), market competition remains weaker than in other emerging markets, holding back productivity and income growth. Using firm-level data from Orbis for 2002–2021, this paper studies the evolution of market competition in ME&CA economies and examines how trade policy and institutions shape competitive dynamics. We find that market power remains substantial and uneven across ME&CA, with particularly high markups in resource-intensive activities, selected service sectors, and—more recently—manufacturing in the Caucasus and Central Asia (CCA). Higher tariff protection is systematically associated with faster growth in markups, indicating that trade barriers weaken competitive pressure, while improvements in competition policy, anti-corruption frameworks, and property rights are linked to declining market power and hence increasing competition. Although productivity gaps remain large and persistent, stronger competition is associated with faster firm-level productivity growth and higher GDP per capita growth, with these effects particularly pronounced in CCA economies. Overall, the findings highlight the importance of policies aimed at reducing trade barriers and strengthening institutional and competition policy frameworks to foster competition, raise productivity, and support long-term income growth in the ME&CA region.
abstract_zh: 在中东和中亚大部分地区，市场竞争仍弱于其他新兴市场，这抑制了生产率和收入增长。本文利用Orbis数据库2002-2021年的企业层面数据，研究中东和中亚经济体的市场竞争演变，并考察贸易政策和制度如何塑造竞争动态。我们发现，中东和中亚地区的市场势力依然显著且分布不均，资源密集型活动、部分服务业以及近期高加索和中亚地区的制造业中，加成率尤其偏高。更高的关税保护与加成率的更快增长系统性相关，表明贸易壁垒削弱了竞争压力；而竞争政策、反腐败框架和产权制度的改善则与市场势力下降（即竞争增强）相关联。尽管生产率差距依然巨大且持续存在，但更强的竞争与企业层面生产率的更快增长以及更高的人均GDP增长相关，这些效应在高加索和中亚经济体中尤为显著。总体而言，研究结果强调了旨在降低贸易壁垒、加强制度和竞争政策框架的政策重要性，以促进竞争、提高生产率并支持中东和中亚地区的长期收入增长。

title: U.S. Agriculture, Biofuel Markets, and Trade: Challenges and Opportunities
title_zh: 美国农业、生物燃料市场与贸易：挑战与机遇
title_primary: 美国农业、生物燃料市场与贸易：挑战与机遇
title_secondary: U.S. Agriculture, Biofuel Markets, and Trade: Challenges and Opportunities
authors: Rayan Wolf, Farzad Taheripour
official: 官方在线 2026-07-15 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Using an enhanced Computable General Equilibrium (CGE) model (GTAP‐BIO), this study assesses how the expansion in demand for Electric Vehicles (EVs) and the reduction in exports of agricultural products induced by trade disputes negatively affect US agriculture. It then evaluates the extent to which producing Sustainable Aviation Fuels (SAFs) from corn and soybeans could mitigate these effects. Results show that EV expansion reduces gasoline demand, suppresses corn production, lowers farm incomes, and generates idled capacity, including increases in uncultivated cropland. Export tariffs further amplify these effects. Expansion in SAF produced from corn and soybean could partially limit these consequences.
abstract_zh: 本研究采用增强型可计算一般均衡（CGE）模型（GTAP-BIO），评估电动汽车（EV）需求扩张及贸易争端导致的农产品出口减少对美国农业的负面影响，并进一步分析利用玉米和大豆生产可持续航空燃料（SAFs）在多大程度上能够缓解这些影响。结果表明，电动汽车扩张降低了汽油需求，抑制了玉米生产，减少了农业收入，并导致产能闲置，包括未耕种农田面积的增加。出口关税进一步放大了这些效应。扩大以玉米和大豆为原料的可持续航空燃料生产可在一定程度上限制上述后果。

title: Anchoring of inflation expectations and the role of monetary policy and cost‐push factors
title_zh: 通胀预期的锚定及货币政策与成本推动因素的作用
title_primary: 通胀预期的锚定及货币政策与成本推动因素的作用
title_secondary: Anchoring of inflation expectations and the role of monetary policy and cost‐push factors
authors: Robert L. Czudaj
official: 官方在线 2026-07-10 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This paper studies the anchoring of inflation expectations at the individual forecaster level. It proposes a novel measure of anchoring based on both point and density forecasts, and uses data from the European Central Bank Survey of Professional Forecasters to examine its co‐movement with expectations about monetary policy and key cost‐push factors. The anchoring measure is constructed for each forecaster and regressed on expectations regarding the European Central Bank policy rate, crude oil prices, the US dollar/euro exchange rate, and unit labor costs. Although the cross‐sectional mean of long‐term inflation expectations appears largely stable, substantial heterogeneity emerges during periods of heightened macroeconomic uncertainty, with some forecasters exhibiting signs of de‐anchoring. The results show that individual anchoring is systematically related to expectations about future policy rates and unit labor cost changes. In addition, these relationships have strengthened since 2020 and display asymmetries depending on whether inflation expectations lie above or below the target.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文从个体预测者层面研究通胀预期的锚定情况。本文提出了一种基于点预测和密度预测的新型锚定度量方法，并利用欧洲央行专业预测者调查数据，考察其与货币政策预期及关键成本推动因素之间的协同变动关系。该锚定度量针对每位预测者构建，并基于其对欧洲央行政策利率、原油价格、美元/欧元汇率及单位劳动力成本的预期进行回归分析。尽管长期通胀预期的截面均值总体保持稳定，但在宏观经济不确定性加剧时期，预测者之间呈现出显著异质性，部分预测者表现出脱锚迹象。结果表明，个体锚定程度与未来政策利率及单位劳动力成本变化的预期存在系统性关联。此外，自2020年以来，这些关联性有所增强，且根据通胀预期高于或低于目标水平而呈现非对称特征。

title: Tax incentives and firm compliance: Evidence from China
title_zh: 税收激励与企业合规：来自中国的证据
title_primary: 税收激励与企业合规：来自中国的证据
title_secondary: Tax incentives and firm compliance: Evidence from China
authors: Jingjing Fu, Zhikuo Liu, Shuyi Wang, Xiaolu Zhao
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-01 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We examine how tax policy affects firm compliance, drawing on a 2003 tax incentive implementation campaign in Chongqing, China. Local officials promoted a preferential corporate income tax rate treatment (15% versus 33%) under the Western Development Project through door-to-door visits. Using a difference-in-differences design, we find that firms became more likely to report positive profits at the extensive margin, leading to higher declared profits and tax payments. For newly compliant firms, the increases came from reported sales and costs rather than real growth in investment or employment. In contrast, consistently compliant firms raised investment and employment, while output did not increase significantly in the short run. Overall, these responses increased local fiscal revenue by about 24%. The findings show that compliance can be improved not only by deterrence but also by credible and favorable tax regimes.
abstract_zh: 我们基于2003年重庆市实施的一项税收激励政策，考察税收政策如何影响企业合规行为。当地官员通过上门走访，在西部大开发项目下推广优惠企业所得税税率（15%对33%）。采用双重差分设计，我们发现企业在广泛边际上更有可能报告正利润，从而导致申报利润和纳税额增加。对于新合规企业，增长主要来自申报的销售额和成本，而非投资或就业的实际增长。相比之下，持续合规的企业增加了投资和就业，但短期内产出并未显著增长。总体而言，这些反应使地方财政收入增加了约24%。研究结果表明，合规性不仅可以通过威慑手段提升，还可以通过可信且优惠的税收制度来改善。

title: What Happens to Diet Quality When Food Prices Rise? Revealed Preference From National Household Scanner Data, 2015–2018
title_zh: 食品价格上涨时饮食质量如何变化？基于2015–2018年全国家庭扫描数据的显示性偏好分析
title_primary: 食品价格上涨时饮食质量如何变化？基于2015–2018年全国家庭扫描数据的显示性偏好分析
title_secondary: What Happens to Diet Quality When Food Prices Rise? Revealed Preference From National Household Scanner Data, 2015–2018
authors: Kate Schneider Lecy, Bangyao Sun, Sean B. Cash, Wenhui Feng, Andrew Thorne‐Lyman 等
official: 官方在线 2026-06-25 · 来源：RSS
abstract: How food prices affect diet quality is an important question to design policies that can improve the nutrition and health of all Americans. This study investigates the association between food‐at‐home diet quality and aggregate food prices to understand if price movements compromise nutrition, and where price‐based policies could be an effective tool to improve population health. Using detailed household purchase data from 2015 to 2018, our findings suggest three insights. First, consumers make substitutions that largely preserve their given level of diet quality, though that level remains poor relative to recommendations for health. Second, we find minimal evidence of heterogeneous responsiveness to prices by diet quality or sociodemographic characteristics. Third, we find evidence that the substitutions consumers make in their protein choices when prices rise increase the healthfulness of their food baskets. Taken together, our study suggests that encouraging healthier diets probably requires more than pricing policies but that price‐based policies targeted at protein may be more effective than other food groups. That we fail to find evidence of differential responsiveness of diet quality to prices suggests that universal (untargeted) policies can be recommended to improve diets across the population. JEL Classification: D12, I12, Q18
abstract_zh: 食品价格如何影响膳食质量，是设计改善全体美国人营养与健康政策的关键问题。本研究探究家庭食品膳食质量与总体食品价格之间的关联，以理解价格波动是否损害营养状况，以及基于价格的政策能否成为改善人口健康的有效工具。利用2015年至2018年的详细家庭购买数据，我们的发现揭示了三个要点。首先，消费者进行的替代行为大体上维持了其既有的膳食质量水平，尽管该水平相对于健康建议而言仍然较差。其次，我们几乎没有发现膳食质量或社会人口特征对价格存在异质性响应程度的证据。第三，我们发现证据表明，当价格上涨时，消费者在蛋白质选择上进行的替代行为提高了其食品篮子的健康程度。综合来看，我们的研究表明，鼓励更健康的膳食可能不仅需要定价政策，但针对蛋白质的基于价格的政策可能比其他食品类别更有效。我们未能发现膳食质量对价格存在差异化响应程度的证据，这表明可以推荐普遍性（非针对性）政策来改善全体人口的膳食。

title: 破解“协而难治”：分层式组织与特色农业产业协同治理

title: DP21636 The Geography of Market Power: Firm Location, Spatial Rents, and Their Social Costs
title_zh: 市场势力的地理分布：企业区位、空间租金及其社会成本
title_primary: 市场势力的地理分布：企业区位、空间租金及其社会成本
title_secondary: DP21636 The Geography of Market Power: Firm Location, Spatial Rents, and Their Social Costs
authors: Marleen Marra, Florian Oswald
official: 官方在线 2026-06-17 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper studies spatial rents in markets where firm location determines competitive advantage. Using the London bus market—where operators maintain proprietary garage networks and bid for route contracts—we develop a structural model linking garage value to procurement profits through transportation (dead-mile) costs, local monopoly rents, and economies of density. Exploiting the exclusive use of garages, we recast the location prob- lem as one where garages choose operators, yielding a tractable discrete choice estimator. Model estimates and simulations reveal a clear tension between minimising dead-mile costs and maintaining spatial isolation from competitors to protect local monopoly rents. A so- cial planner reassigning garage ownership can recover up to 24.3% in welfare gains through reduced spatial isolation alone. In addition, adding a Pigouvian correction for dead-mile ex- ternalities contributes 2.0% through a channel that does not require displacing incumbents. Sizeable gains remain un- der short-run fleet constraints and under conservative assumptions about the social cost of disrupting incumbent-specific investments.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了企业区位决定竞争优势的市场中的空间租金。以伦敦公交市场为背景——该市场中运营商拥有专属车库网络并竞标线路合同——我们构建了一个结构模型，通过运输（空驶）成本、本地垄断租金和密度经济将车库价值与采购利润联系起来。利用车库的排他性使用特征，我们将区位问题重新表述为车库选择运营商的问题，从而得到一个易于处理的离散选择估计量。模型估计与模拟揭示了在最小化空驶成本与保持与竞争对手的空间隔离以保护本地垄断租金之间的明显张力。若由社会规划者重新分配车库所有权，仅通过减少空间隔离即可实现高达24.3%的福利改善。此外，针对空驶外部性引入庇古校正，通过不涉及替代在位运营商的渠道额外贡献2.0%的福利提升。在短期车队约束条件下，以及关于破坏在位运营商特定投资的社会成本的保守假设下，仍存在可观的福利改进空间。

title: Preemptive Entry and Technology Diffusion: The Market for Drive‐In Theaters
title_zh: 先发进入与技术扩散：汽车影院市场
title_primary: 先发进入与技术扩散：汽车影院市场
title_secondary: Preemptive Entry and Technology Diffusion: The Market for Drive‐In Theaters
authors: Ricard Gil, Jean‐François Houde, Shilong Sun, Yuya Takahashi
official: 官方在线 2026-06-18 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This article studies entry preemption in new industries. We first test a key prediction of dynamic entry games: Entry preemption is most relevant in intermediate‐sized markets, where firms face highest uncertainty about future entry. Using US drive‐in theater market (1945–1957) data, we find robust evidence for this non‐monotonic relationship between market size and early entry probability. We then estimate a dynamic entry game, and quantify preemption effects through counterfactual analysis. Preemptive motives increase early entry by up to 40% in mid‐size markets, raising entry costs by 5% and reducing firms' expected value by 1%.
abstract_zh: 本文研究新产业中的进入抢占行为。我们首先检验动态进入博弈的一个关键预测：进入抢占在中等规模市场中最为显著，因为此时企业面临最大的未来进入不确定性。利用美国汽车影院市场（1945-1957年）的数据，我们发现了市场规模与早期进入概率之间呈非单调关系的稳健证据。随后，我们估计了一个动态进入博弈模型，并通过反事实分析量化了抢占效应。在中等规模市场中，抢占动机使早期进入率最高增加40%，导致进入成本上升5%，并使企业预期价值降低1%。

title: Downstream centrality and industry lobbying in production networks
title_zh: 生产网络中的下游中心性与行业游说
title_primary: 生产网络中的下游中心性与行业游说
title_secondary: Downstream centrality and industry lobbying in production networks
authors: Kwok Ping Tsang
official: 官方在线 2026-06-10 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Which industries lobby the most? I study whether an industry’s position in the production network is associated with reported federal lobbying. The argument is that supplying many downstream customers creates two forces. A policy that helps a supplier can raise privately appropriable stakes when downstream benefits are partly capitalized back to the supplier through derived demand, supplier surplus, contracts, or preservation of customer relationships. The same downstream reach also expands the set of beneficiaries that can free-ride. The model therefore predicts a hump-shaped relationship between downstream reach and focal-industry lobbying. Using a panel of 71 U.S. industries from 1999 to 2023, I find a nonmonotone pattern in mapped LDA lobbying expenditures. The pattern appears in every annual cross-section and is stronger on spending among active industries than on lobbying entry. The estimates are descriptive and apply first to mapped spending. Only about one-third of reported spending maps cleanly to industries, and partial-identification bounds show that inference becomes weaker once the unmapped remainder is taken into account.
abstract_zh: 哪些行业游说支出最高？本文研究行业在生产网络中的位置是否与其联邦游说报告存在关联。核心论点在于：为众多下游客户供货会形成两种作用力。当下游收益通过派生需求、供应商盈余、合同关系或客户关系维护等渠道部分资本化回流至供应商时，有利于供应商的政策可能提升其可私人占有的利益规模。但同样的下游覆盖范围也会扩大可搭便车的受益群体。据此，模型预测下游覆盖范围与焦点行业游说支出呈驼峰型关系。基于1999年至2023年71个美国行业的面板数据，我发现映射至LDA游说支出的数据呈现非单调模式。该模式在每年度横截面数据中均存在，且对活跃行业游说支出的影响强度大于游说进入行为。这些估计结果具有描述性特征，首先适用于可映射的游说支出。在报告的总游说支出中，仅约三分之一能清晰映射至具体行业，而部分识别边界显示，一旦考虑未映射的剩余部分，推断效力将显著减弱。

title: Wasserstein worst-case scenarios and asset pricing
title_zh: Wasserstein最坏情形与资产定价
title_primary: Wasserstein最坏情形与资产定价
title_secondary: Wasserstein worst-case scenarios and asset pricing
authors: Zhonghui Zhang, Fushu Luan, Chihwa Kao
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-03 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We develop a framework for decision-making under model uncertainty, grounded in Wasserstein distributionally robust optimization. In contrast to standard Kullback–Leibler approaches constrained by absolute continuity, Wasserstein ambiguity sets constructed via optimal transport permit the adversary to physically relocate probability mass to new states, capturing economically relevant support-shifting distortions—structural breaks, regime shifts, and catastrophic tail events—that the reference model excludes entirely. We integrate these state-shift distortions into both static and recursive dynamic decision problems, where agents optimize against the worst-case distribution within a transport budget. A data-driven bootstrap calibration procedure disciplines the degree of robustness by linking the ambiguity radius to statistical confidence sets. Applying the framework to asset pricing, we show that endogenous belief distortions amplify perceived variance, inducing precautionary savings that lower the risk-free rate and widen the equity premium. The geometric uncertainty propagates through persistent state dynamics, generating endogenous stochastic volatility akin to long-run risk. The resulting pricing kernel aligns with empirical Hansen–Jagannathan bounds without requiring implausibly high risk aversion or non-standard preferences.
abstract_zh: 我们构建了一个在模型不确定性下进行决策的框架，其基础是Wasserstein分布鲁棒优化。与受绝对连续性约束的标准Kullback–Leibler方法不同，通过最优传输构建的Wasserstein模糊集允许对抗者将概率质量物理性地移动到新状态，从而捕捉参考模型完全排除的、具有经济相关性的支持转移扭曲——结构性断裂、制度变迁和灾难性尾部事件。我们将这些状态转移扭曲整合到静态和递归动态决策问题中，其中代理在传输预算内针对最坏情况分布进行优化。一种数据驱动的自助法校准程序通过将模糊半径与统计置信集联系起来，对鲁棒性程度加以约束。将该框架应用于资产定价，我们表明内生信念扭曲会放大感知方差，引发预防性储蓄，从而降低无风险利率并扩大股权溢价。几何不确定性通过持久的状态动态传播，产生类似于长期风险的内生随机波动性。由此产生的定价核与经验上的Hansen–Jagannathan边界一致，而无需假设过高的风险厌恶或非标准偏好。

title: Measuring the effect of shocks on inequality: It’s all about the data
title_zh: 衡量冲击对不平等的影响：关键在于数据
title_primary: 衡量冲击对不平等的影响：关键在于数据
title_secondary: Measuring the effect of shocks on inequality: It’s all about the data
authors: Marie Hogan, Laura E. Jackson, Michael T. Owyang
source: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-16 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: To identify shocks in VARs using short-run sign or exclusion restrictions, the highest-frequency data possible is usually preferred. For income inequality, there is tension be-tween high frequency and high quality. Annual datasets that survey large numbers of people provide high-quality estimates of income. Higher frequency surveys generally provide a sparser sampling of individual income. Some previous studies have used the higher frequency data, presumably to match the frequency necessary to identify the shock. Using data obtained from the higher frequency, lower respondent surveys might result in misleading conclusions. We combine the two surveys and construct a set of quarterly-frequency income quantiles that are scaled to the annual data but (cid:135)uctuate according to the high-frequency survey. We show that using these data yields di⁄erent economic conclusions than simply using the raw high-frequency income series. In particular, we show in two simple applications to technology shocks and house price shocks that one obtains di⁄erent conclusions about the permanence and/or the direction of the responses of income inequality
abstract_zh: 为了利用短期符号或排除限制来识别VAR中的冲击，通常倾向于使用尽可能高频的数据。然而，对于收入不平等而言，高频与高质量之间存在张力。每年调查大量人群的数据集能提供高质量的估计收入，而更高频率的调查通常对个人收入的抽样更为稀疏。一些先前的研究使用了较高频率的数据，推测是为了匹配识别冲击所需的频率。使用来自高频但受访者较少的数据可能导致误导性结论。我们结合两种调查，构建了一组季度频率的收入分位数，这些分位数按年度数据缩放，但根据高频调查波动。我们表明，使用这些数据得出的经济结论与直接使用原始高频收入序列不同。特别是，在两个简单应用中——技术冲击和房价冲击——我们发现关于收入不平等响应的持久性和/或方向会得出不同结论。

title: Identifying macroeconomic shocks using firm-level data: Material shortages in the German manufacturing sector
title_zh: 利用企业层面数据识别宏观经济冲击：德国制造业的原材料短缺
title_primary: 利用企业层面数据识别宏观经济冲击：德国制造业的原材料短缺
title_secondary: Identifying macroeconomic shocks using firm-level data: Material shortages in the German manufacturing sector
authors: Friederike Fourné, Lara Zarges
source: Journal of Economic Dynamics and Control
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-04-11 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We leverage microdata to identify macro shocks in time series settings. We exploit firm-level forecast errors on prices and production along with information on production impediments to construct a shock series capturing input material constraints. The resulting shock series is not related to other common macro economic shocks, but is correlated with major events that likely triggered input material constraints. We find that tightening shocks have a persistent effect on prices, while the negative impact on production is short-lived. However, industrial production remains subdued for an extended period. Decomposing the instrument into its individual components allows to contrast the response to input material shocks with that to any other generic supply shock. Additionally, we demonstrate that the construction of the shock series is robust to variations in the underlying identification assumptions at the micro-level.
abstract_zh: 我们利用微观数据来识别时间序列设定中的宏观冲击。通过结合企业在价格和生产方面的预测误差以及生产障碍的相关信息，我们构建了一个捕捉投入材料约束的冲击序列。该冲击序列与其他常见宏观经济冲击无关，但与可能引发投入材料约束的重大事件相关联。研究发现，紧缩性冲击对价格具有持续性影响，而对生产的负面效应则是短暂的。然而，工业产出在较长时期内仍保持低迷。将工具变量分解为其各个组成部分，可以对比投入材料冲击与任何其他一般性供给冲击的响应差异。此外，我们证明该冲击序列的构建对微观层面潜在识别假设的变化具有稳健性。

title: Old firms and the relationship between age and size
title_zh: 老企业与年龄和规模之间的关系
title_primary: 老企业与年龄和规模之间的关系
title_secondary: Old firms and the relationship between age and size
authors: Filip Rozsypal, Svend Greniman Andersen
official: 官方在线 2026-03-09 · 来源：RSS
abstract: If old firms are, on average, much larger than young firms, does this mean that firms get better with age? Using Danish administrative data on firms aged 0–65, we study the relationship between size and age. In the cross-section, average size is increasing with age. However, by exploiting the panel structure through the estimation of fixed effects or by using a partial identification approach to the so-called age–period–cohort problem, we find evidence that firm size increases with age only for the first 10–15 years, and falls after that. Moreover, sample composition effects seem to be important to understand the patterns in the cross-section: we find significant differences in exit rates by firm size and strong cohort effects for firms entering in the late 1950s. We also find that the exit rate is not monotonically decreasing with age; for smaller firms, it starts increasing again in their 20s, spiking in their late 30s.
abstract_zh: 如果老企业平均而言远大于年轻企业，这是否意味着企业会随年龄增长而变得更好？利用丹麦0至65岁企业的行政数据，我们研究了规模与年龄之间的关系。在横截面上，平均规模随年龄增长而增加。然而，通过利用面板结构进行固定效应估计，或采用部分识别方法处理所谓的年龄-时期-队列问题，我们发现企业规模仅在最初10至15年内随年龄增长，之后则下降。此外，样本构成效应似乎对理解横截面模式至关重要：我们发现不同规模企业的退出率存在显著差异，且对1950年代末期进入的企业存在强烈的队列效应。我们还发现，退出率并非随年龄单调递减；对于较小企业，退出率在20多岁时再次上升，并在30多岁后期达到峰值。

title: Market regulation and productivity: The case of the Canadian Wheat Board
title_zh: 市场规制与生产率：以加拿大小麦局为例
title_primary: 市场规制与生产率：以加拿大小麦局为例
title_secondary: Market regulation and productivity: The case of the Canadian Wheat Board
authors: Ryan Cardwell, Pascal L. Ghazalian
official: 官方在线 2025-10-29 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Changes to regulatory environments influence firm-level incentives, which can move the productivity frontier or reposition firms within an existing frontier. Estimating causal effects of policy changes requires a credible counterfactual for productivity in the absence of policy change. We estimate causal effects of a major policy change in agricultural markets; deregulation of the Canadian Wheat Board. The Canadian Wheat Board was a state-trading enterprise that controlled sale and distribution of wheat and barley produced in Western Canada through a single-desk monopsony from 1943 to 2012. We investigate how deregulation affected farm-level productivity for regulated crops. Field-level production and input data for 13,000 farms over 17 years are used to generate a within-farm difference-in-differences estimate of how relative productivity changed between regulated and unregulated crops when the single-desk mandate was removed. Our within-farm approach identifies the effects of regime change while controlling for factors that confound productivity estimation in other approaches, including unobserved time-varying factors at the farm level. We identify significant positive effects of deregulation on farm-level productivity of spring wheat. We also find heterogeneous effects across fields with different land productivity, and across farms with different levels of experience marketing their unregulated crops outside the single-desk. Broadly, we find that deregulation of the Canadian Wheat Board's monopsonistic single desk incentivized farms to increase productivity of wheat. This research contributes to the understanding of how policy interventions can affect firm-level productivity, and to the productivity literature with an estimation strategy for identifying productivity effects in the context of multi-output firms.
abstract_zh: 监管环境的变化会影响企业层面的激励，从而可能推动生产率前沿的移动或使企业在现有前沿内重新定位。评估政策变化的因果效应需要一个在没有政策变化情况下生产率的可信反事实。我们评估了农业市场一项重大政策变化的因果效应——加拿大小麦委员会放松管制。加拿大小麦委员会是一个国有贸易企业，从1943年到2012年通过单一垄断渠道控制着加拿大西部生产的小麦和大麦的销售与分配。我们研究了放松管制如何影响受监管作物的农场层面生产率。利用17年间13,000个农场的田间层面生产和投入数据，我们生成了农场内部双重差分估计，以衡量在单一垄断授权被取消后，受监管与未受监管作物之间相对生产率的变化。我们的农场内部方法在控制其他方法中混淆生产率估计的因素（包括农场层面未观测到的时变因素）的同时，识别了制度变化的影响。我们发现放松管制对春小麦农场层面生产率产生了显著的正向效应。我们还发现，在不同土地生产率的田块之间，以及在不同水平经验在单一垄断之外销售其未受监管作物的农场之间，存在异质性效应。总体而言，我们发现加拿大小麦委员会垄断性单一渠道的放松管制激励了农场提高小麦生产率。这项研究有助于理解政策干预如何影响企业层面生产率，并为多产出企业背景下识别生产率效应的估计策略贡献于生产率文献。

title: The Timing of State Visits: Examining Their Role in Shaping Deal Duration
title_zh: 国事访问的时机：探讨其对交易持续时间的影响
title_primary: 国事访问的时机：探讨其对交易持续时间的影响
title_secondary: The Timing of State Visits: Examining Their Role in Shaping Deal Duration
authors: Chandrika Raghavendra, Kedar Pandurang Joshi, M. Ramkumar
official: 官方在线 2025-10-10 · 来源：RSS
abstract: This study examines how state visits influence the duration of cross-border acquisitions (CBAs), addressing a key gap in economic diplomacy research. Analysing 33,798 inbound and 33,121 outbound U.S.-involved CBAs from 1990–2023, the findings reveal that state visits significantly shorten deal durations. The reduction in deal duration is more pronounced in advanced economies during the visit year, while in emerging economies, the impact is observed with a lag. Large and small acquirers can reduce the delay period during the state visit year. Minority stake and cross-industry acquisitions experience greater reductions in duration than majority or same-industry deals. Overall, state visits facilitate quicker deal completion and foster global economic collaboration. The study offers strategic insights for policymakers and multinational firms aiming to streamline international M&A activities.

title: How blockchain innovation affects corporate transparency: evidence from Chinese-listed firms
title_zh: 区块链创新如何影响企业透明度：来自中国上市公司的证据
title_primary: 区块链创新如何影响企业透明度：来自中国上市公司的证据
title_secondary: How blockchain innovation affects corporate transparency: evidence from Chinese-listed firms
authors: Rui Chang Kexin Sun Renyu Zhang Xuyan Wang Zeshi Xu a Institute for Big Data Science, Tianjin Normal University, Tianjin, Chinab College of Management and Economics, Tianjin University, Tianjin, Chinac Business School 等
official: 官方在线 2025-08-19 · 来源：RSS
abstract: Corporate transparency is essential for effective governance, as it mitigates information asymmetry between internal and external stakeholders. Blockchain’s decentralized, immutable, and traceable features offer a novel solution for improving operational transparency. Drawing upon agency theory, this study investigates how and to what extent blockchain innovation affects corporate transparency. Based on data from firms listed on the Shanghai and Shenzhen stock exchanges (A-share market) during the period 2017–2023, the results show that blockchain innovation significantly enhances corporate transparency. Additionally, we further explore the impact mechanisms of external supervision on the relationship between blockchain innovation and corporate transparency. The results find that both media supervision and institutional investors amplify the positive effect of blockchain innovation on corporate transparency. This study contributes to interdisciplinary research at the intersection of information technology and corporate governance by demonstrating how blockchain technology can enhance corporate transparency.
abstract_zh: 企业透明度对于有效治理至关重要，因为它能缓解内外部利益相关者之间的信息不对称。区块链的去中心化、不可篡改和可追溯特性为提升运营透明度提供了全新解决方案。基于委托代理理论，本研究探讨了区块链创新如何以及在多大程度上影响企业透明度。基于2017-2023年沪深两市A股上市公司数据，结果表明区块链创新显著提升了企业透明度。此外，我们进一步探究了外部监督对区块链创新与企业透明度关系的调节机制。研究发现，媒体监督和机构投资者均能强化区块链创新对企业透明度的正向促进作用。本研究通过论证区块链技术如何提升企业透明度，为信息技术与公司治理交叉领域的跨学科研究做出了贡献。
